description: This Java class 'ProductStoreSurveyWrapper' extends 'SurveyWrapper' and manages survey rendering for product store applications within the OFBiz framework. It handles survey templates, results, and response logic.

classes.name: ProductStoreSurveyWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for handling product store survey rendering and response logic within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: callResult
methods.description: Sets the callResult flag indicating whether the survey call has been made.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the survey or result based on response status and templates.
